profile.headline: Hard working professional
profile.summary: I have extensive knowledge in automotive and diesel technology stemming from UTI and other educations. My father was a General contractor so I grew up learning everything there is about building a house. After that I worked at a finish carpentry shop making all kinds of wooden furniture. Then onto my automotive career and I have continued to collect skills and trades along the way. I am quick to adapt and learn new things very fast. I would be an excellent addition to any team but also work well alone if need be. I have recently gone back to school for massage therapy as well as UX/UI design. I have been studying massage therapy for 2 years now and am very close to graduating. I recently started UX/UI design but am picking it up quickly. I would love an opportunity to intern or start entry level UX designer for a company that would be willing to teach me along the way.
